title: xenophyllum weddellii
intro: Xenophyllum weddellii, commonly known as Weddell's calceolaria, is a plant species in the family Calceolariaceae. It is a flowering plant native to Peru, used in traditional medicine for its medicinal properties. The plant is said to have health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in reducing inflammation and fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of Xenophyllum weddellii include alkaloids and flavonoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as promoting wound healing and reducing pain.
